CREATE TABLE records(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category INTEGER, score REAL, name TEXT, payload BLOB, optional INTEGER)

SELECT * FROM records ORDER BY id
SELECT category,count(*) AS count,sum(score) AS total,avg(score) AS average,min(score) AS minimum,max(score) AS maximum FROM records GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

SELECT id,length(payload),hex(payload),optional IS NULL,coalesce(optional,-1) FROM records WHERE id>? ORDER BY id
UPDATE records SET score=score+10 WHERE category=?
DELETE FROM records WHERE id%2=0

SELECT * FROM records ORDER BY id
